item.title: ABC News: Tucabia man who missed 1993 Christmas lunch is likely dead, coroner says
item.description: Stephen Bryant was invited to a neighbour's house for Christmas lunch more than 30 years ago, but he never arrived and has not been seen since.

item.title: ABC News: 'Massive win' for Australia as Solomon Islands scraps China security deal
item.description: Solomon Islands has told China it is scraping its controversial 2022 security pact, as the Pacific Island nation prepares to sign a sweeping near billion-dollar treaty with Australia.

item.title: ABC News: Drones, protests and new legal powers — what is in the new defence bill?
item.description: New legal powers aimed at better protecting Australia's defence bases have been quickly pushed through parliament, attracting controversy over a lack of scrutiny.

item.title: ABC News: Business owner banned from employing migrants
item.description: An Adelaide restaurant operator has been banned from employing migrant workers until 2029.

item.title: ABC News: Man accused of child abuse and drug offences in remote community
item.description: A 48-year-old man accused of a string of child abuse and drug offences in a remote community has his case raised in Katherine Local Court.

item.title: ABC News: Massive illegal fishing bust in northern waters alarms industry
item.description: Australian Border Force has seized a foreign fishing vessel north of Darwin allegedly carrying more than 25 tonnes of frozen fish.

item.title: ABC News: Man acquitted of murdering Melbourne photographer due to psychotic illness
item.description: A former immigration detainee who bashed a 62-year-old news photographer to death has been acquitted of murder on mental health grounds.

item.title: ABC News: Australia's most affordable city masking a 'two-tier' rental system: expert
item.description: Canberra is the most affordable city in Australia for renters, but an expert says that is only half the story and high average incomes are masking a "two-tier" system.

item.title: ABC News: Suncorp rakes in billions, now an allegedly 'toxic' culture is being exposed
item.description: Suncorp insures millions of Australians but a whistleblower says the company has incentivised staff to make claims payouts difficult for customers.

item.title: ABC News: Coalition turns against security pact with Vanuatu over net zero clause
item.description: The $500 million deal is a key part of the strategic architecture the government has built to reinforce Australia's position in the Pacific and stop China from gaining a military foothold.

item.title: ABC News: Job losses feared after $20m slashed from Victorian specialist schools
item.description: Saints College offers young people aged 12 to 25 an alternative to mainstream education, often providing assistance to the state's most vulnerable and marginalised children.

item.title: ABC News: Driver climbs on car roof after Townsville crash
item.description: Queensland Police are searching for footage of a dramatic traffic incident involving a man who climbed onto the roof of a vehicle after a crash.
